reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate FitBark
reauth_confirm.description: Your FitBark access has expired or been revoked. Please log in again to continue.

abort.already_configured: This FitBark account is already configured.
abort.missing_configuration: The FitBark integration is not configured. Please follow the documentation to add application credentials first.

init.title: Sensor polling interval
init.description: How often to refresh the activity/goal/minutes/battery sensors. FitBark's collar sync isn't continuous, so shorter intervals mostly just re-fetch unchanged values.

statistics.title: Statistics import interval
statistics.description: How often to import hourly activity history into long-term statistics (Developer Tools → Statistics). FitBark's finest tracked resolution is hourly, so below 1 hour has no benefit.

application_credentials.description: Enter the `client_id` and `client_secret` from your FitBark developer application. Register `{redirect_url}` as the app's redirect URI before continuing -- see {more_info_url}.
